We have two positions (1 left, 2 right).  
- From “satire is left of fantasy”, satire must be at position 1 and fantasy at position 2.  
- “Coffee drinker is in an even position” → coffee at position 2 (the only even position). Thus juice is at position 1.  
- “Fisherman is right of musician” → musician at position 1, fisherman at position 2.

So the assignments are:  
Position 1: juice, musician, satire  
Position 2: coffee, fisherman, fantasy  

Answers:  
- Satire’s position: 1  
- Job of coffee drinker: fisherman  
- Beverage at position 2: coffee  
- Job of juice drinker: musician  

<solution>1, fisherman, coffee, musician</solution>  
Final answer: 1, fisherman, coffee, musician
